metadata.description: Portable Agent Skills for AI coding agents, editors, and assistants — built for practical, reusable engineering and editorial workflows.

plugins.name: openai-realtime-webrtc
plugins.description: Build low-latency voice AI agents with OpenAI Realtime API over WebRTC, ephemeral session tokens, RTCPeerConnection audio, and data channel tools.

plugins.name: restate-sdk
plugins.description: Build resilient sagas, durable workflows, and stateful virtual objects with @restatedev/restate-sdk, deterministic journaling, and awakeable promises.

plugins.name: use-telegram-serverless
plugins.description: Build, ship, and scale simple or full-stack Telegram bots and Mini Apps on Telegram Serverless with V8 JS, SQLite (sdk/db), Mini App RPC, and tgcloud.

plugins.name: telegram-serverless-bot
plugins.description: Build, ship, and test Telegram bots on Telegram Serverless with V8 JS, SQLite sessions (sdk/db), interactive keyboards, and Telegram Stars (XTR).

plugins.name: discord-activities
plugins.description: Build, ship, and test Discord Activities with @discord/embedded-app-sdk, OAuth2 token exchange, reverse proxy CSP routing, and voice channel presence.

plugins.name: openauth
plugins.description: Deploy self-hosted OAuth2 and OIDC servers with OpenAuth, createSubjects schemas, prebuilt PasswordUI and CodeUI, and cross-framework client verification.

plugins.name: cloudflare-email-workers
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and test Cloudflare Email Routing Workers with postal-mime MIME parsing, RFC 5322 mimetext replies, and AI auto-response loops.

plugins.name: mtcute
plugins.description: Build high-performance Telegram userbots and MTProto client apps using @mtcute/node, @mtcute/dispatcher, SQLite sessions, and typed raw TL calls.

plugins.name: duckdb-wasm
plugins.description: Query Parquet files, run in-browser analytical SQL, and persist databases to OPFS with @duckdb/duckdb-wasm, Web Workers, and Apache Arrow tables.

plugins.name: humanize-text
plugins.description: Write and rewrite natural, human-authored prose across articles, technical guides, and documentation while preserving voice, meaning, and nuance.
